answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared reef of escrowed deposits before it can trade, and let reputation grow only through completed work verified by random peers. A new identity starts with velvet-smooth promises but zero history, so it earns slowly while an orchard of long-lived agents with proven harvests gets priority. Spinning up a thousand fakes means locking a thousand stakes and waiting through the same slow earning curve, so the attack costs more than the rewards it could steal.
